### 2026-10-28: # Displays!

**1h**

# Displays!
## What I did
- Spent time brainstorming the project for this week. My thought process: I wanted to use an OLED display for my project, that I knew, but to do what? I was looking at the OLED guide, and it mentioned a pomodoro timer. People like productivity devices, right? So I could make that! How can I distinguish though? I could also add a temperature/humidity sensor to give the user alerts on optimal productivity conditions! So that is the concept for Brain Breeze.
- I started listing out some of the key components for the PCB. I will use Alibaba as my supplier.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/s5X6uAidfBv2Me3zVHdgxREVUKqtvsIM/4178a645669e667cdc39047a31cdc3f1b4680ec54a29b52abf00857ff95a1bda.png)
- I downloaded the XIAO hardware design libraries, needed for the footprint of XIAO RP2040 in KiCad.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/s5X6uAidfBv2Me3zVHdgxREVUKqtvsIM/dda325bac434817bf997e48cfd93428835b498ed7f5baa76c7612d4ec08e170e.png)

## What I will do next
I have not actually started designing anything on KiCad yet, so I will do that next time.
